item.title: Internet voting is insecure and should not be used in public elections
item.description:
📝 All internet voting systems are insecure. Internet voting systems known as “End-to-End Verifiable Internet Voting” are also insecure, in their own special ways. All deployed Internet voting systems are unsafe, VoteSecure is unsafe and isn’t even a deployed voting system, and there is no known (or foreseeable) technology that can make Internet voting safe.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.citp.princeton.edu/2026/01/16/internet-voting-is-insecure-and-should-not-be-used-in-public-elections/

item.title: Significant US Farm Losses Persist, Despite Federal Assistance
item.description:
📝 When operating expenses and farm-wide costs like equipment, land and management are combined, costs vary widely by crop. In 2025, total operating costs ranged from $155 per acre for wheat to more than $764 per acre for rice and $631 per acre for peanuts. In fact, returns over total costs for all nine principal row crops are projected to remain negative on a per-acre basis even after accounting for federal assistance.
🔗 Read more: https://www.fb.org/market-intel/significant-farm-losses-persist-despite-federal-assistance
